game_title: Compound Combo – Lava River Crossing Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the forge anvil using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The forge anvil reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the forge anvil is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The forge anvil reached with actions_used <= 15.
